input.summary: Extend the §13.1 grant to Affiliates and contractors, remove revocation at Vendor's discretion, and permit successor transfer
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, removed revocation at Vendor's sole discretion, and confirmed transferability to an Affiliate or successor, consistent with our playbook position and with Sections 13.2 and 13.3 as drafted. As a fallback we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice and successor transfer limited to an M&A transaction.

ops.oldText: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf, a licence to use the Services for Customer's and its Affiliates' business purposes. The licence is transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3 and is revocable or suspendable only as expressly permitted by Section 13.3.
